title: Update Nightscout REST API to v3
symptom: The issue requests support for the new Nightscout REST API to track changes and deletions better, listing tasks to implement.
evidence_quote: I have been told the following two statements. - xDrip does not delete or update any records. Therefore, there is no need to change from V1 to V3. - Since AAPS 3.2, if AAPS uses xDrip as the CGM source, AAPS does all the uploading to Nightscout. Taking those into consideration, I am closing this issue.
